verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no built-in natural-language command interface. It does document its own MCP server at git.cafe/mcp, which lets AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT read repositories and, with approval, work on issues and pull requests. It also offers WebMCP tools to in-browser agents, agent skills for coding assistants, and a button that hands issues and pull requests to coding agents, so natural-language operation works only through an external AI client. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command surface inside GitCafe, documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on evidence that natural-language operation works in practice.
